responsibility: Implements RISC-V target behavior for C-family front ends. Its main responsibility is defining preprocessor macros that describe the active ISA, ABI, code model, floating-point and vector capabilities, and per-extension version numbers, using the parsed subset list as input; it also registers and handles `#pragma riscv intrinsic`, dispatching vector intrinsic enablement and routing builtin-call semantic checks to the RVV subsystem.
